parent_objective: materialize denominator-source inventory for M2138 panel units and M2125 measured profiles
blocked_by: M2140 must design denominator-source inventory before materialization
supersedes: direct ranking before denominator availability is proven

public_gates: M2141 must materialize denominator inventory from existing artifacts only
M2141 must include the complete M2125 measured profile universe
M2141 must preserve generated-proxy and paper-validity claim boundaries
M2141 must not execute comparison or policy rollouts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not edit RL implementation code except the inventory materializer if needed
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat comparison-support smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes denominator availability evidence for panel-unit/profile cells
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: denominator inventory only; no controller ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if materialization runs new rollouts
stop if materialization ignores missing denominator rows
stop if materialization ignores generated-proxy paper-validity boundary
fallback_plan: route to denominator inventory audit if artifacts are clean
route to controlled rerun design if denominator rows are unavailable
route to synthesis if denominator inventory cannot change the branch verdict
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2140 admits no-rerun denominator-source inventory materialization

blocked_shortcuts: do not rank profiles in M2141
do not run measured execution in M2141
do not treat generated smoke proxies as paper-valid tasks
allowed_updates: M2141 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for denominator inventory audit or controlled rerun design
next_stage_criteria: next audit or fallback route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2141 materializes denominator inventory and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2141.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2138 support matrix, M2128 outcome-by-profile-source-kind rows, and M2125 measured artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If denominator inventory is incomplete, record missing rows and route to controlled rerun design or synthesis.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns support-only panel units into denominator availability evidence across the full measured profile universe
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether denominator-backed comparison design is possible but cannot make a paper verdict directly
must_synthesize_if: M2141 finds denominator inventory cannot change the next route

hypothesis: Existing M2125/M2128 artifacts contain complete no-rerun denominator rows for M2138 panel units across the measured profile universe.
success_criteria: all expected panel-unit/profile denominator rows are available
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: denominator rows are missing duplicate or nonfinite
ranking or paper-level claims are made
claim boundary is missing or violated

commands.name: materialize
commands.command: write M2141 no-rerun denominator inventory artifacts from M2138 M2128 and M2125 artifacts

decision_rule: M2141 passes if it writes complete denominator inventory artifacts without ranking.
